checks.name: interface: the arena’s interface bank loads with the lobby; a tab press plays its selection sound on the interface bus
banks: the loadout’s weapon, the ground’s footsteps, movement, handling and impacts load on their own while deploying (decoded at their own rates; decoder delay measured from the marker)
checks.detail: 17 banks ready 1021 ms after deployment; delays 0 ms; 32.8 MB decoded

checks.name: own gunfire through the game: the Vanguard’s recorded body, its tail at the crossfade, and the spent 5.56 case landing

tactical reload: grab, magazine release, out, a fresh one from the pouch, in, seated, settle — each part’s loudest moment at the moment the animation reaches it (within a frame); no bolt, no dropped magazine
checks.detail: grab +0 · magRelease -1 · magOut +0 · pouch +0 · magIn +0 · magSeat -1 · settle +2 ms (frame tolerance 60 ms)

checks.name: reload from empty: the empty magazine drops to the ground on what is underfoot, the new one goes in, and the bolt catch sends the bolt home — in time with the animation
checks.detail: grab → magRelease → magOut → pouch → magDrop → magIn → magSeat → boltRelease → settle; bolt 0 ms off

checks.name: interrupted reload: switching weapons at 40 % stops the reload’s sounds; magazine-in and seat never play; the switch and the secondary’s draw are heard
footsteps: from the gait while walking (cadence from speed), on the surface under the player, stopping when the player stops; quiet clothing under some steps
checks.detail: 7 steps every 394 ms on steps.asphalt, steps.concrete; 3 clothing/equipment layers

checks.name: hit reactions: two hits 40 ms apart make one heavier grunt; helmet, plate carrier and cloth each sound different; an elimination plays once (a female soldier’s voice, then the body falling); the player’s own hit grunts quietly
checks.detail: voice.mC/heavy, impacts/helmet, impacts/armour, impacts/flesh, voice.fA/death, movement/bodyfall, movement/gearHeavy, impacts/armour, voice.mA/hurt

checks.detail: grab → magRelease → magOut → magDrop → pouch → magIn → magSeat → chargeBack → chargeFwd → settle

checks.name: 3 s firefight (12 shooters of every weapon, own automatic fire, explosions, impacts): no clipping, voices within budget, cheap calls
checks.detail: peak -5.6 dBFS, 0 clipped samples (100 % of the output inspected), 767 calls, 591 played / 750 skipped / 169 stolen, ≤ 20 voices, 0.115 ms per call

checks.name: distance: 4 m plays the weapon’s near recording and tail; 45 m blends in the mid-distance microphone; 130 m only the far version
occlusion and roofs: the engine agrees with an independent line-of-sight check on 8 points around the player; the warehouse interior is under a roof (indoor reverb)
ambience: the map’s wind, district and room-tone beds are looping (and the nearest machines)
category volumes: weapons at 0 → the player’s own shot is silent in the arena mix; at 1 it is back; the announcer plays on its own bus

memory: after a firefight with every weapon in the game heard, decoded audio stays within the phone budget (least recently used banks let go; a weapon whose bank is reloading is stood in for by one of its class)
a suspended audio context (phone interruption) is resumed by the next sound or touch; nothing queues up meanwhile
